en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a townscape with a prominent round medieval tower with a conical roof (Torre Verde) near a line of trees and low buildings with red-tiled roofs, backed by hills. In the foreground is an open grassy area with paths and a few people walking. The caption in red text at the top reads in Italian about Trento and the tram station.
